# Data Source: identitynow_managed_cluster

Use this data source to look up a managed cluster by ID or name, e.g. to reference the virtual appliance cluster of a source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_managed_cluster" "va_cluster" {
  name = "Primary VA Cluster"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Managed cluster ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Managed cluster name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `alert_key` (String) Key describing any immediate cluster alerts.
- `ccg_version` (String) CCG version used by the cluster.
- `client_ids` (List of String) IDs of the clients of the cluster.
- `client_type` (String) Type of the clients of the cluster, e.g. `VA` or `CCG`.
- `configuration` (Map of String) Map of all cluster configuration entries.
- `consolidated_health_indicators_status` (String) Consolidated health status of the cluster.
- `created_at` (String) Creation date.
- `current_installed_release_version` (String) Release installed on the cluster.
- `description` (String) Description of the cluster.
- `operational` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is operational.
- `org` (String) Org (tenant) of the cluster.
- `pinned_config` (Boolean) Whether the cluster configuration is pinned.
- `pod` (String) Pod of the cluster.
- `public_key` (String) Public key of the cluster.
- `public_key_certificate` (String) Public key certificate of the cluster.
- `public_key_thumbprint` (String) Public key thumbprint of the cluster.
- `service_count` (Number) Number of services bound to the cluster.
- `status` (String) Cluster status, e.g. `NORMAL`, `NO_CLIENTS` or `FAILED`.
- `type` (String) Cluster type.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update date.
